title: Scenario configuration (E1)
description: The scenario matrix and the coupling controls. Per-scenario variant references stay in scenarios/S*.json, which bind a scenario to its network, schedule, land use, parking, signals, demand and parameter sets; this layer holds the values those configs share.

E.matrix.scenario_ids.description: The scenario matrix, fixed at P0. S2 vs S0 is the headline test, S2 vs S3 the value-for-money test, S2 vs S4/S5 the trunk-length test.

E.matrix.day_types.description: Full weekend day types are built, not a weekday-only model with a note. Beach and event demand is arguably this system strongest use case and excluding it would bias against the light rail (DECISIONS.md 1 item 5).

E.matrix.base_year.description: Base year, using 2021 Census marginals with HTS 2024/25 behaviour.

E.matrix.crs.description: GDA94 / MGA Zone 56, metres. The proposal label GDA2020 was corrected.

E.replication.n_replications.sweep_basis: proposal 5.2 specifies at least 30 SUMO replications; the sweep records that cutting replications is one of the three levers on the run budget
E.replication.n_replications.description: Seeded replications per scenario. One of the three things that can be cut to close the run-budget gap - the others being sweep breadth and day types. Sample fraction is the WEAKEST lever because cost is sublinear in it.

sweep.basis: no basis has been established; the interval brackets a plausible stability criterion on a 12-minute corridor run time and is a placeholder for a decision, not a decision

E.coupling.outer_loop_tolerance_s.description: Corridor run-time stability tolerance for the MATSim-SUMO outer loop. Proposal 5.2 defers this explicitly - run the loop 'until the corridor run time is stable within a tolerance TO BE DEFINED AT CALIBRATION'. IT HAS NOT BEEN DEFINED. This is a P4 obligation that appeared on no deliverable list until issue 8. Registered with a null value so it cannot be silently assumed by whoever builds the loop.
